title: The Erdős–Turán Conjecture on Additive Bases
statement_plain: If A is a subset of the natural numbers such that every sufficiently large integer can be written as a sum of two elements of A (an asymptotic additive basis of order 2), then the representation function r_A(n) = |{(a, b) in A x A : a + b = n}| must be unbounded.
